description.value: Mount Pleasant Community Centre is a Vancouver Park Board facility in the heart of the Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, serving the local community with fitness and recreation programs. Its location on Kingsway places it along a busy cycling corridor connecting downtown Vancouver to East Vancouver. As a public community centre, it offers basic amenities that touring cyclists passing through may find useful.
